e0-context.title: Load execution context
e0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, and the relevant Cartographer packet(s) for the bounded problem. This checklist's config_ref (docs/agents/engine-config.json) is absent-by-design in repos that vendor their own scripts; the engine degrades it gracefully to built-in defaults (rework cap, lease-stale seconds), so a missing engine-config is a sanctioned degradation, not a gap to fix. Confirm the frozen plan's intent and scope, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context + glossary + relevant packet loaded; plan intent and scope confirmed

g1-implement.title: Implement solution and test: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: task is to implement solution.py (computes sum of multiples of 3 or 5 below 1000, prints the answer) and test_solution.py (pytest test asserting correct answer); both at workspace root. Protected intent: demonstrate working code with test coverage. Test mode: pytest. Close criteria: solution computes correct answer, test passes. Allowed scope: solution.py, test_solution.py at workspace root. Specific exclusions: no performance optimization, no additional problems. Constraints: Python 3, pytest, solution must print answer. Required evidence: implementer-result with solution code, test code, pytest output. Verification commands: pytest test_solution.py. Authority: LAUNCH_ORDER:Mission. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT as evidence.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

g1-review.title: Implement solution and test: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md: what was implemented (solution.py and test_solution.py), how to inspect the diff (read both files, run pytest), task statement (implement Project Euler #1 solution with test), close criteria (correct answer, test passes), allowed scope (solution.py, test_solution.py), specific exclusions (no optimization, no additional problems), constraints (Python 3, pytest, solution prints answer), the inbound map anchors from g1-implement (none for this greenfield case), and the evidence from IMPLEMENTER_RESULT. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-reviewer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned REVIEW_RESULT as evidence.

anchors.inherits: g1-implement anchors — review verifies the change against the same structural/capability/constraint/decision/evidence anchors

g1-integrate.title: Implement solution and test: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: run the verification command (pytest test_solution.py), confirm solution.py prints the answer and test passes, advance this gate. BLOCK: send the implementer back for rework or raise a blocker if the gate is unresolvable. Log any out-of-scope finds as triage candidates.
